div.div:
Why one account per court
· pure data segmentation — no shared database, no shared bucket
· per-court billing, straight off the AWS invoice
· independent version rollout — one court upgrades without the others
· fork-and-leave portability — a court can take its instance and go

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 247, 230), rgb(31, 24, 10)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(216, 102, 19), rgb(216, 118, 46));

div.div:
Shared across every account
· AWS Bedrock — LLM inference, via LiteLLM in each Django app
· the portal image — one Docker Hub tag, deployed to every court
A shared docassemble is the one proposed exception, and the
thing to re-argue against this model.
